verdict.rationale: Together has a dedicated rate-limits doc page explaining that limits are dynamic per organization and per model, adjusting with live model capacity and your recent successful usage. Related pages note that batch jobs use a separate rate-limit pool and dedicated endpoints have no hard rate limits. The docs explain how limits scale, but by design there are no fixed published thresholds or tier tables, so a developer cannot see concrete numbers before reaching production. Missing for 10: concrete per-tier or per-model numeric limits, an explicit usage-tier scaling table, guidance on detecting limits (e.g. headers), and independent corroboration.
